circuit.role: termination switch: photo-MOS relay in series with the termination, LED from +3V3 through 330 ohm to an expander pin driven low
circuit.page: this design; relay data sheet not read

supplies.I_standby_uA: VCC 1 typ / 2 max, plus VIO 9 typ / 14 max

logic: TXD/RXD/STB at VIO (3.3 V); logic inputs tolerate 6 V (p4). STB has an internal pull-up: unconnected = standby.
placement: At the bench header; CAN_H/CAN_L as a pair; thermal pad to ground with vias (p3).
notes: CAN FD to 8 Mbit/s. In standby it wakes on a bus pattern and signals it by pulling RXD low (p17-18): CAN_RX is not a wake pad, so wake-on-CAN would need a SNVS line.
Termination: simplest honest alternative to the relay is a 2-pin jumper position on the header that bridges in the 120 ohm.
